📰 General

Apple Tests Paid Siri AI Limits and iCloud+ Upgrades in New Beta •

Apple is implementing restrictions on the use of Siri AI and Apple Intelligence features within the latest iOS 27.3, iPadOS 27.3, and macOS 27.3 beta releases. The updates introduce daily usage allowances for Siri AI across all Apple devices. Furthermore, Apple is beginning to test paid upgrades for iCloud+ subscriptions, offering enhanced capabilities related to Apple Intelligence. These changes represent a shift towards a tiered system for accessing advanced AI features within the Apple ecosystem.

🌍 World

Le Pen Announces Halt to Ukraine Aid, Pledges Immediate Action Upon Election •

French far-right leader Marine Le Pen has stated her intention to cease all financial support for Ukraine within six months of assuming the presidency. She argues that France currently lacks the necessary funds to continue providing assistance. Le Pen’s announcement represents a significant departure from previous statements and a clear stance against ongoing military and humanitarian aid to Ukraine. The move follows concerns about France’s economic situation and a desire to prioritize domestic needs.

🦅 US

iOS 27.3 Beta Adds Face Unlock Feature for iPhone Duo Users •

The latest iOS 27.3 beta release includes a new face recognition feature specifically designed for iPhone Duo devices. Users can now unlock their iPhones by simply looking at the device. This functionality represents a significant update for iPhone Duo owners. Apple is currently testing this feature as part of the beta program before a wider release.

💰 Business

Delta CEO Claims ATL to LGA Flight Now Slower Than in the 1950s •

Delta Air Lines CEO Ed Bastian stated that the flight time between Atlanta (ATL) and LaGuardia (LGA) is now longer than it was when the route initially launched in the 1950s. Bastian made the comment during the Fortune 500 Innovation Forum, describing the increased travel time as “absurd.” The FAA attributed the delays to air traffic congestion and weather conditions impacting the New York airspace. The CEO’s remarks highlight ongoing challenges in air travel within the densely populated Northeast corridor.

💻 Technology

Apple Introduces Facial Unlock for iPhone 14 & 15 in iOS 27.3 Beta •

Apple has implemented a new facial recognition unlock feature for the iPhone 14 and iPhone 15 models. This functionality is included in the second iOS 27.3 beta release, offering users an alternative method to access their devices. The feature utilizes the front-facing camera to authenticate users. Apple is providing users with increased security options alongside existing methods like passcode and Touch ID.

🎭 Entertainment

Louis Carr Steps Down as BET President Following Skydance TV Shift •

Louis Carr is leaving his role as President of BET after approximately a year in the position. The departure was announced internally by George Cheeks, Co-Chair and Chief Content Officer of Skydance TV. Carr’s exit is part of a broader restructuring within Skydance TV’s content division. Details regarding his future plans have not yet been released. The move signals a shift in leadership at BET under Skydance TV’s ownership.

🏅 Sports

Michigan State Rises in AP Top 25 Following Impressive Duke Victory; Kentucky Falls •

Following a decisive win against Duke, Michigan State has entered the Associated Press Top 25 poll for the first time this season, marking a notable shift in the rankings. The AP poll experienced a significant shakeup due to just one preseason top-10 team losing its first game. Kentucky was subsequently dropped from the poll after a loss to Alabama. This change reflects the early volatility expected in college basketball’s rankings. The updated poll now features 25 teams, with several other programs seeing adjustments in their positions.

🔬 Science

SpaceX’s Starship Launch Reaffirms Company’s Foundation as a Rocket Builder •

SpaceX’s successful orbital test flight of Starship, the world’s largest and most powerful rocket, is being viewed by analysts as a crucial validation of the company’s core business. The launch demonstrated the vehicle’s capabilities for heavy-lift launches, a key component of SpaceX’s ambitions in space transportation. The flight’s success reinforces the company’s primary focus on developing and operating rockets, rather than solely relying on its ambitious ambitions for space tourism and colonization. 🩺 Health

Ancient “Disease of Kings,” Characterized by Intense Pain, Is Seeing a Modern Resurgence •

Cases of the condition, historically known as “disease of kings,” have experienced a significant increase in recent years. The ailment, marked by debilitating and persistent pain, was previously associated with individuals of high social status. Researchers are observing a more than 20% rise in reported cases, prompting renewed investigation into its causes and treatment. Experts believe factors such as increased stress and lifestyle choices may be contributing to the resurgence of this long-standing illness.
